parameters.content:
# Target selection (use cases covered)
## Single target
- attack a player
- attack an iron golem or other mob
- attack an animal
- if target location is unspecified, teleport workers to leader location (must get coordinates of the leader)


## Multiple targets
-  leader <leader name> workers


## Workers (warriors)
- teleport-workers teleports all workers in the session to target locatiok

combatPlan.tacticalsummary: Deploy two soldiers to hunt the nearest cow with a coordinated approach.

battlefieldAssessment.recommendations: Utilize open spaces to quickly locate and engage the target.

soldierInstructions.objective: Locate and hunt the nearest cow
soldierInstructions.positioning: approach the target directly from the front

healthManagement.action: disengage immediately and move to rally point

constraints: Stay within 30 blocks of the target
Maintain a safe distance from other soldiers
If target flees, break off and regroup
soldierInstructions.instructionText: Equip your best melee weapon. Search for the nearest cow within 30 blocks. Engage directly and attack it. Maintain a safe distance from Soldier2 and attack for up to 60 seconds. If your health drops below 6 hearts (12 HP), retreat immediately.

soldierInstructions.objective: Hunt the nearest cow with a supportive approach
soldierInstructions.tactic: Support from an alternative angle to maximize efficiency

healthManagement.action: disengage immediately and move to rally point

constraints: Stay within 30 blocks of the target
Coordinate with Soldier1 to avoid crowding
If target flees, reassess and support Soldier1
soldierInstructions.instructionText: Wait 1.5 seconds, then equip your best melee weapon. Search for the nearest cow in proximity to Soldier1. Approach from a different angle and engage. Maintain cooperative distance with Soldier1 and attack for up to 60 seconds. Retreat if health drops below 6 hearts (12 HP).

combatPlan.victoryCondition: The cow is successfully hunted and both soldiers retreat safely.
combatPlan.failureCondition: Unable to locate or engage the cow successfully within 60 seconds.
combatPlan.safetyNotes: Prioritize soldier safety, ensure both can disengage cleanly.
